title: Editor E0 task 14, Space slice: the Space page writer stores node documents when render_path_space_profile is on
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19. saveSpaceProfileLayout reads renderPathEnabled('space_profile'): on, an incoming native node document is sanitized with sanitizeNodeLayout and stored as nodes; publish and discard no longer refuse over stored nodes. Off, or a stale legacy save over stored nodes, keeps the LIVE-887 refusal. Honest gaps: nothing sends a node document yet (the store and Space canvas still send type-keyed rows), and a native draft equal to the published page is not auto-cleared.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/profile/actions.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!s.includes(\"renderPathEnabled('space_profile')\"))bad.push('writer does not read the flag');if(!s.includes('sanitizeNodeLayout(layout'))bad.push('native branch does not sanitize');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1003: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Space writer stops reading the flag or stops sanitizing a native document. Behavior is actions.render-path.test.ts.
